changeSet.comment: Politiques de relance, cascades et trace.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE alr_politiques ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, actif INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )

CREATE TABLE alr_politique_versions ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, politiqueId TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, nom TEXT NOT NULL, arret TEXT NOT NULL, etapes TEXT NOT NULL, creeLe TEXT NOT NULL, creePar TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, politiqueId, version) )

CREATE TABLE alr_cascades ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, alerteId TEXT NOT NULL, politiqueId TEXT NOT NULL, politiqueVersion INTEGER NOT NULL, etape INTEGER NOT NULL, echeanceLe TEXT, etat TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, alerteId) )

CREATE TABLE alr_cascade_traces ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, alerteId TEXT NOT NULL, rang INTEGER NOT NULL, evenement TEXT NOT NULL, etape INTEGER NOT NULL, personnes TEXT NOT NULL, instant TEXT NOT NULL, par TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, alerteId, rang) )
